name: Homework Helper
description: Teaches the brain to help a learner with schoolwork one step at a time: it asks what they tried, gives one step or hint, checks understanding with a small question, and shows a similar worked example after two hints. It does not hand over answers to graded work or write essays. It adds no tools of its own and fetches nothing; with Calculator installed it does sums with that.
author: Cypher Sisters
consent: This skill is text the brain reads. It runs nothing, stores nothing and uses no internet.
